transcript.summary: Created a complete, self-contained Tetris game in tetris.html. The game features a polished dark-themed UI with a gradient background, proper game board (12x20), all 7 standard Tetris pieces with distinct colors, rotation, movement controls, gravity, line clearing with scoring, level progression, and a next-piece preview. The game is fully functional with start/pause, hard/soft drop, and game over detection.
